modules.module_title: Procurement of raw materials and Arrange tools and Equipment

pcs.pc_description: identify the raw materials required as per product specifications
ensure raw material are as per product requirement both in terms of quality and quantity
identify the appropriate amount of munj and khar (another form of grass) based on the job specifications
arrange the suitable dyes and colors as per the product requirement required for coloring the objects
place appropriate quantity of water in a drum based on the job specification
arrange needle of appropriate size and dimensions required for shaping the iron object with a rounded head for grip
place Knife of standard size required for slitting the grass to extract excess amount of pieces
arrange twine, takua and blade of appropriate sizes required for pierce the needle for stitching the craft
place the sliver by slicing the grass in the right manner
shave the slivers for smoothness and the desired size
measure and maintain the uniformity of the sliver to be achieved
maintain the sharpness of the equipment used in slicing and shaping of grass objects
identify the required tools and equipment for slicing and processing the raw materials as per product specification
perform the standard process required for soaking the slivers in water for a period of time to make them more pliable
place khar and munj provide the basic shape and additional strength to the grass objects
identify the colors and shade from shade card based on the job specification
place the object of grass in the water along with dye or chemical colors and make them boiled till the appropriate temperature and time required for coloring the grass object

modules.module_title: Colouring of slivers as per the product and design requirements

pcs.pc_description: select the correct dyeing vessel and chemicals/colors for dyeing the required grass slivers as per specifications
perform the process of mixing the different chemicals/ingredients required for making the dye bath
apply the standard operating procedures in order to maintain proportions while measuring and mixing chemicals
demonstrate the standard operating procedures for heating the dye bath to desired degrees
place and dip and grass objects in order to ensure complete immersion of the slivers in the dye bath correctly
estimate the duration dip for the desired results
apply standard safety procedures in order to take necessary precautions to avoid uneven dyeing of materials
maintain the concentration of the dye bath
apply standard operation procedures for washing and neutralizing the dyed slivers or sticks appropriately
minimise and dispose the leftover chemicals in the approved manner
perform the standard operating procedures in order to dry the dyed slivers/ sticks avoiding direct sunlight & dust
apply the standard operating procedures for sorting & separating out the dried dyed slivers/ sticks based on color
prepare unit bunches/ bundles of slivers/ sticks as per convenience for next level of processing
store the dyed grass slivers in a dry & dust free area

modules.module_title: Carry out making of hard grass frame as per design and product

pcs.pc_description: select hard grass such as ‘munj’ and ‘Khar’ on the basis of flexibility
perform standard procedures for cutting the hard grass in different sizes as per the design and product requirement
apply the standard procedures required for smoothing the surface of grass with shaver to avoid any cuts on hands
demonstrate the process of allowing the object to get the required basic shape of hard grass to provide additional strength to the grass products
take specific type (based on width & length) of Hard Grass slivers suitable for preparing the two-dimensional base structure
plan out the base & fix it to obtain a rigid structure
ensure that the base structure is fixed in a proper manner before coiling the grass slivers on to the base structure
make the two dimensional hard grass base according to required design & pattern

modules.module_title: Coiling and twining of grass slivers on frame

pcs.pc_description: take appropriate grass slivers (based on width & length) for coiling and twining on base structure frame formed by hard grass according to shape, size, colour & design pattern required in making specific product
perform basic coiling of grass slivers on the given structure/frame
analyze and maintain uniform gap between the slivers as per the given specification
analyze and maintain compactness of the sliver to ensure rigidity of the structure
demonstrate the use different colored slivers for different patterns
avoid overlapping in coils to obtain uniformity and quality
analyze and maintain quality in giving shapes
ensure proper handling in making the product to avoid any breakage

modules.module_title: Carry out finishing, varnishing, drying & storage of final grass craft product

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate the cutting operation in order to cut the extra edges neatly to give the fine finished look by using clipping tools
analyze and apply glue to fix the edges
maintaining sharpness of clipping tool and take safety precaution while clipping
prepare the solution of varnish by adding an appropriate amount of thinner
apply solution on the product uniformly and handle the product properly while doing varnishing
ensure uniform and complete drying in sunlight to avoid stickiness
check & ensure the quality of the final product based on requirement
take precautions while stacking the lot of products avoiding any breakage
